description: This file defines a React component named UsersList that displays a list of users in a table with filtering, searching, and optional delete actions. It manages state, fetches user data from an API, and renders a UI with filters and a data table.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches all users from the API and updates component state.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Sets the user to be deleted, triggering the delete confirmation modal.

methods.name: resetFilters
methods.description: Resets all filters and search queries to show the full user list.

methods.name: handleRowClick
methods.description: Handles row click events, delegating to parent callbacks.
